From 518828fcdfc8c1246fc3ea022e74934d4f6bd76f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Brenda J. Butler" <bjb@mojatatu.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Oct 2017 17:59:22 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] tc-testing: fix arg to ip command: -s -> -n

Fixes: 31c2611b66e0 ("selftests: Introduce a new test case to tc testsuite")
Fixes: 76b903ee198d ("selftests: Introduce tc testsuite")
Signed-off-by: Brenda J. Butler <bjb@mojatatu.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py b/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py
index 5f11f5d7456e..a8981c5d0aaf 100755
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py
@@ -152,11 +152,11 @@ def ns_create():
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
         cmd = 'ip link set $DEV0 up'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
-        cmd = 'ip -s $NS link set $DEV1 up'
+        cmd = 'ip -n $NS link set $DEV1 up'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
         cmd = 'ip link set $DEV2 netns $NS'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
-        cmd = 'ip -s $NS link set $DEV2 up'
+        cmd = 'ip -n $NS link set $DEV2 up'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
 
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py`**
- The command `ip -s $NS link set $DEV1 up` was modified to `ip -n $NS link set $DEV1 up`.
- The command `ip -s $NS link set $DEV2 up` was modified to `ip -n $NS link set $DEV2 up`.

### Relationships
The modifications in `tdc.py` involve changing the argument passed to the `ip` command from `-s` (which stands for "statistics") to `-n` (which stands for "no statistics"). This change is intended to correct the functionality of the test cases introduced in previous commits, specifically addressing issues related to the execution of the `ip` command within the network namespace. The patch is linked to two previous commits that introduced the test cases to the tc testsuite, indicating that the original implementation had a bug that this patch aims to fix.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by using the incorrect argument `-s` with the `ip` command, which was intended to display statistics but was not suitable for the context of setting the link state within a network namespace. The correct argument should have been `-n`, which specifies the network namespace without displaying statistics, leading to potential failures in executing the command as intended.
